test_title: PYST 5: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 28 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A & B means ‘A is the wife of B’.

A # B means ‘A is the father of B’.

A @ B means ‘A is the son B’.

A% B means ‘A is the husband of B’.

A+B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

If A & B # C & D @ E % F + G, then how is C related to F?
solution:
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/381bb324031e492a954560753fb70857a2102f092925049991d50c75954ae833.png] **

**Given: **A & B # C & D @ E % F + G

**Decoding the signs: **

 
 

 Signs
 &
 #
 @
 %
 +
 
 

 Coded as
 wife 
 father 
 son
 husband 
 mother 
 
 

 A & B # C & D @ E % F + G → It means that A is the wife of B, B is the father of C, C is the wife of D, D is the son of E, E is the mother of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72f7b965b47d295bd6fb3a85f3402e2f3e515e9a27c7a4ae75df606d750f241a.png] 

Thus, C is the Daughter-in-law of F.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
